scope: Proposition 20.1 of the manuscript “Boundary graph deformations for the spacetime Penrose inequality” (preprints/Boundary-graph-deformations-for-the-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4205f51d8f1b130b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 138. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix the strict data, ϵ, a sufficiently large N, and any of the homotopy stages of Section 18. Every smooth solution on an allowed finite truncation with t ≥ −ϵ has uniform local bounds for every finite number of derivatives of f and Z, including up to the inner and outer boundary faces. On the uniform unit patches on the end these constants are independent of the outer truncation radius and of the stage parameter. They may depend arbitrarily on N. In particular, on a fixed finite truncation they bound the C1,α norm of Z for each fixed 0 < α < 1.
